capabilities: Expose REST endpoints for Obsidian-only plugin features via Local REST API
Dispatch Templater, Dataview, Tasks, Excalidraw, Git and Remotely Save operations to the MCP server
Reuse Local REST API bearer-token authentication
Migrate settings from the formerly named Reliquary-TC version on first load
disambiguation: A small optional bridge plugin, not the reliquary-tc MCP server itself; every filesystem-level server feature works without it.
extras: Most of the linked README documents the reliquary-tc MCP server, not the plugin; plugin-specific detail is deferred to packages/plugin/README.md. Desktop-only. The repo notes that headline retrieval figures were withdrawn as unreproducible (relevant to the server, not this bridge).
intentEvidence: It extends Local REST API with endpoints for Obsidian-only features (Templater, Dataview, Tasks, Excalidraw, Git, Remotely Save)
problem: External MCP servers can read vault files directly but cannot reach Obsidian-internal plugin features like Templater, Dataview, Tasks, Excalidraw, Git or Remotely Save.

summary: Companion bridge plugin that extends Local REST API with endpoints exposing Obsidian-only plugins to the reliquary-tc MCP server.
